title: Assimilation of Satellite Flood Likelihood Data Improves Inundation Mapping From a Simulation Library System
datasets: Copernicus GloFAS Global Flood Monitoring flood-likelihood product

idea.research_question: How do GloFAS Global Flood Monitoring flood-likelihood patterns describe the extent and uncertainty of flooding across Pakistan impact zones?
idea.hypothesis: High GFM flood likelihood forms coherent event footprints while the product's exclusion mask identifies areas where SAR-derived flood interpretation is unreliable.
idea.mechanism: Retrieve GFM likelihood, flood, permanent-water and exclusion-mask layers for an event window, aggregate valid observations by impact zone, and compare likelihood gradients across floodplain contexts.
idea.analytical_approach: Single-source GloFAS Global Flood Monitoring event mapping and uncertainty analysis
idea.expected_contribution: A reproducible public single-dataset benchmark for GFM flood-likelihood mapping without the commercial Flood Foresight simulation library.
idea.falsification_condition: Reject the hypothesis if high-likelihood pixels are not spatially coherent across repeat event acquisitions after applying the supplied exclusion and permanent-water masks.

seed_audit.migration_note: Migrated from dual_dataset/task_035 on 2026-10-07; the commercial JBA Flood Foresight maps are removed from the active contract, leaving only public GloFAS GFM flood likelihood.
